items.title: Jack Palmer interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 24, 1997
items.q: It was a lot of bands. And I was with Teddy Powell. And I come out and I did a vocal I think, I’m not sure anymore. Yeah, Teddy Powell’s band.

ctx.x: Did you ever get involved on any of those band movies? Those short movies they did?

Yeah. I made one with Teddy Powell. I think the name, yes, I remember the name, “Jam Session.” It was a lot of bands. And I was with Teddy Powell. And I come out and I did a vocal I think, I’m not sure anymore. Yeah, Teddy Powell’s band.
We should get a copy of that.
